description_en: Queries the audio and video parameters of an upstream ingest stream within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询一段时间内的流的上行推流的音视频参数
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-up-video-audio-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stream rtmp://example.com/AppName/StreamName --start-time 2015-12-10T15:00:00Z --end-time 2015-12-10T15:10:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveUpVideoAudioInfo

parameters.help_en: The full name of the stream to query. The format is `rtmp://<ingest domain>/<AppName>/<StreamName>`
parameters.help_zh: 查询的流名，需要完整填写，格式为：`rtmp://推流域名/app名/流名`
parameters.name: stream

parameters.help_en: The start time. The format is \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The format is \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` in UTC
parameters.name: end_time
